title: Deposit function can be DOSed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, while core contract functionality would be DOSed, it's still possible to bypass attack using a private relayer  **Likelihood:** Medium, the attack vector is cheap, but at the same time malicious actor has no incentive except griefing users  ## Description  The deposit function requires that the sum of fixed and variable deposits be strictly equal to the `fixedSideCapacity` and `variableSideCapacity` correspondingly.
